email.body1:
Drew, saw Anaqua acquire Patrix and add nearly 400 IP customers, alongside the RightHub win at Premier Tech.

Growth like that opens more in-market accounts across your connectivity motion than the team can cover before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Anaqua off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Drew, quick follow-up for Anaqua.

With Patrix and RightHub expanding the footprint across the Americas and EMEA, the target list grows faster than the team does. Most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Anaqua needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Drew, last bit of proof for Anaqua.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Anaqua's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Drew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Selling across regions through a busy acquisition year is its own kind of full plate and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Anaqua either way.
